products.reason_for_recall: Maxivision MaxiFlex (Registered) Multinutrient Formula, 120 Vegetable Capsules is being recalled because a material review was conducted in April 2015. It revealed some of the Chondroitin Sulfate (Lot 093011 1031) raw material used in the manufacture of Maxiflex Multinutrient Formula Lot 32171215 was Out of Specification.
